description_en: Associates a Resource Access Management (RAM) user or a RAM role with a product portfolio
description_zh: 将产品组合授权给账号内的RAM用户或者RAM角色
kebab_example: aliyun servicecatalog associate-principal-with-portfolio --portfolio-id port-bp1yt7582g0000 --principal-type RamUser --region cn-hangzhou
name: AssociatePrincipalWithPortfolio

parameters.help_en: The ID of the product portfolio
parameters.name: portfolio_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the RAM entity. Valid values:

RamUser: A RAM user.

RamRole: A RAM role
parameters.help_zh:
RAM实体类型。取值：

RamUser：RAM用户。
RamRole：RAM角色
parameters.name: principal_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the RAM entity.

For information about how to obtain the ID of a RAM user, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28681.html.

For information about how to obtain the ID of a RAM role, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28711.html
parameters.help_zh:
RAM实体ID。

获取RAM用户ID的方法，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28681.html。

获取RAM角色ID的方法，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28711.html
parameters.name: principal_id

parameters.help_en: The principal identity pattern. The pattern is in the format of `<PrincipalType>/<PrincipalName>`
parameters.help_zh: RAM实体名称规则，当PrincipalType填写RamPattern时生效。如需配置Ram用户名称规则，格式为user/${userName}；如需配置Ram角色名称规则，格式为role/${roleName}
parameters.name: principal_pattern
